e.title: Longitudinal Reserving (CAS)
e.summary: CAS 准备金工作组纵向方法论文代码：二十年数百家公司公开数据的非寿险纵向准备金研究
e.body: reserves_wg_longitudinal_reserving 是 CAS 准备金工作组（Reserves Working Group）的纵向方法论文代码：用纵向数据分析技术研究非寿险损失准备金——预测已发生未结案理赔的负债，数据为数百家保险公司二十年公开数据。纵向方法（面板数据视角看准备金）是传统链梯之外的新视角。对 RIAA：CAS 官方研究，准备金方法论的前沿扩展。与 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-mmnpp]]（UNSW 系列）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：CAS Reserves Working Group 纵向非寿险准备金论文（20 年数百家公司公开数据）
e.summary_en: CAS reserves-working-group paper code: longitudinal data analysis for non-life loss reserving (20 years of public data from hundreds of companies)
e.summary_hk: CAS 準備金工作組縱向方法論文代碼：二十年數百家公司公開數據的非壽險縱向準備金研究
e.body_en: reserves_wg_longitudinal_reserving is the paper code of the CAS Reserves Working Group: a longitudinal approach to non-life loss reserving using longitudinal-data-analysis techniques — forecasting the liability for incurred-but-not-yet-settled claims, on public data from several hundred insurance companies over twenty years. The longitudinal (panel-data) view of reserving is a new perspective beyond the classic chain ladder. For RIAA: official CAS research extending reserving methodology. Complements [[chainladder]], [[reserving-ensemble]] and [[reserving-mmnpp]] (UNSW series). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: reserves_wg_longitudinal_reserving 是 CAS 準備金工作組（Reserves Working Group）的縱向方法論文代碼：用縱向數據分析技術研究非壽險損失準備金——預測已發生未結案理賠的負債，數據為數百家保險公司二十年公開數據。縱向方法（面板數據視角看準備金）是傳統鏈梯之外的新視角。對 RIAA：CAS 官方研究，準備金方法論的前沿擴展。與 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-mmnpp]]（UNSW 系列）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
